143:221.en: 「$$ジン・ムソウ$$,\nshow me how you fight.」

143:272.en: 「You've exceeded my hopes, $$ジン・ムソウ$$.」

143:305.en: 「I must have let my guard down.」

143:427.en: 「Of course I did that! Now, next!」

143:487.en: 「Thinking about other stuff,\nso you let your guard down?!」

143:536.en: 「$$ジン$$!\nWe're comrades, so rely on me!」

143:647.en: 「Um... How do I put it? So close.」

143:682.en: 「$$ジン$$! Fall back from the enemy!」

143:723.en: 「$$ジン$$, keep trying till you succeed!」

143:964.en: 「I can't do this! We should run!」

143:999.en: 「Now, let's see what you can do!」

143:1214.en: 「Let's see just how good you are.」

143:1405.en: 「You just don't know when to quit!」

143:1626.en: 「Let's see what a Gundam can do.」

143:1822.en: 「Let them pass,\nand $$ヴェーガ$$ is finished!」

143:2025.en: 「Sink that ship, and it's game over!」

143:2147.en: 「Could you hold still for a bit...!」

143:2252.en: 「It tracks you, so you can't dodge.」

143:2432.en: 「I can't let it end in defeat...!」

143:2524.en: 「A plan to split up their forces?」

143:2885.en: 「I'm not dumb enough to rush out.」

143:2924.en: 「Sigh... Guess I have to give up...」

143:3081.en: 「Can't you tell it has no effect?」

143:3256.en: 「This kind of thing's a real pain.」

143:3291.en: 「So you can do worse than predicted.」

143:3742.en: 「Game over, in a place like this...!」

143:3831.en: 「For those who took me in,\nI fight!」

143:3884.en: 「For all who told me I'm needed!」

143:4011.en: 「If you ask, I have to do it.」

143:4278.en: 「You're behind it all! I'll beat you!」

143:4313.en: 「I'll protect both $$アルテア$$ and $$ヴェーガ$$!」

143:4403.en: 「I'll cut this fate of despair short!」

143:4477.en: 「I don't like it... You looking down on us.」

143:4518.en: 「$$ヴェーガ$$ doesn't belong to you people.」

143:4590.en: 「Our feelings go beyond\nwhat you people call fate...!」

143:4715.en: 「I can do this sort of thing too!」

143:4769.en: 「How many did we end up with...?」

143:4893.en: 「Huh. The $$神話型アクエリオン$$'s good too.」

143:4920.en: 「So that's a $$レア・イグラー$$'s power...!」

143:5022.en: 「The $$神話型アクエリオン$$'s no big deal, huh.」

143:5057.en: 「I have to protect the $$レア・イグラー$$!」

143:5113.en: 「This much is easy with my skill.」

143:6010.en: 「$$ユノハ$$!\nEven if it costs my life...」

alternatives: I'll give it all to dig this hole!
I'll dig a hole with all my power!
I'll dig with all my strength!
I'll dig a hole with all I've got!
I'll dig this hole with all I have!

143:6603.en: 「$$ジン$$, leave the support to me!」
